description: List identified-user trait keys such as plan or role, with how many profiles have each and their top values. Use before filtering get_data by trait:<key> or search_replays by user traits.

outputSchema.description: traits holds the most-covered keys, each with up to valuesPerKey top values and the profiles holding them; these values are what trait filters accept. hasMoreKeys and hasMoreValues mark a cut list. identifiedProfiles counts identified users; hint explains an empty result.
